label: Per-design limits
subgoals: Fix a baseline coverage and pattern count per reference design
Fail a design if either metric exceeds its tolerance
Fail the change if any design fails

label: Computing the thresholds
subgoals: Multiply the baseline by one plus the allowance
Round down for the largest passing pattern count
Recompute test coverage from raw counts

label: What the metric can hide
subgoals: Compare detected counts as well as coverage
Check that unchanged fault classes keep the same detections
